positions.title: Autonomy and Robotics Software Engineer
positions.description: Working across the autonomy stack for unmanned aerial systems, with a focus on state estimation, post-flight analysis, and mission planning.

positions.title: GNC Engineer
positions.description: Served as GNC Responsible Engineer for a stratospheric balloon platform

positions.title: GNC Intern
positions.locationName: Huntington Beach, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
- Modeled IMU sensor noise (gyro bias, random walk)
- Ran Monte Carlo simulations to assess state estimation performance and sensitivity to initial orientation.
- Investigated attitude estimation methods and resolved issues in orientation propagation.
- Generated reference trajectories using LQR optimization to minimize state error and control effort.

positions.title: Mechatronics Intern
positions.description:
Led 9-month development cycle of mission-critical walking robot payload to include all necessary sensors and a computational unit that was both aesthetic and mechanically viable. 
Identified and addressed design issues, enhancing sensor systems and computation.
Conceptualized solutions, prototyped designs, and managed manufacturing.
Orchestrated mechatronics integration, ensuring wiring, electronics, and mounting cohesion.
Aligned sensor field-of-view with algorithms for optimal data utilization.

positions.title: Hardware Intern
positions.description:
Assisting in the optimal design and fabrication of components for the robots for maximum resiliency
while minimizing disruption of other subsystems
- Designed, assembled, integrated, and tested foam that would maximize impact protection while
minimizing weight, occlusion, and overheating to mitigate the risk of damaging the hardware
during a crash
- Facilitated the interative design process of both the placement and the mounts for various
sensors to maximize FoV while minimizing risk of damage to increase the probability of detecting
a potentially damaging object, therefore reducing the risk of a crash.
- Took charge of the task of designing and building a Calibration Gate replica used in competition. Contacted manufacturers to construct a modular and easily portable gate that was structurally sound as well.

positions.title: Summer Researcher
positions.description: We tracked the particle movement using Paraview to display the particles trajectories through a computer simulated flow field. The behavior of the particles near the wall was compared to the transport of turbulence. The behavior of the particles injected in the free stream was compared to the location of the TNT interface as well as the boundary layer thickness. To investigate the mixing ability of turbulence, pairs of particles were then injected an infinitesimal distance apart throughout the boundary layer. From these pairs, a time scale was extracted to quantify the time before the two particle paths become completely decorrelated. To fully illustrate these results, we created multiple videos to see this.

positions.title: Lifeguard
positions.description:
- Work at a local city pool to maintain public facilities and patron safety
- Help organize several major aquatic events in the summer
- Taught a swimming class to instruct beginner and intermediate swimmers on basic technique
